_note: Advance-purchase windows. advance_days is how far ahead tickets must be secured to be sure of entry. A plan that says on_arrival or walk_up for one of these venues is a finding.

shibuya-sky.note: Timed-entry tickets are sold online and released 14 days ahead at 00:00 JST. Sunset windows sell out first.

teamlab-planets.note: Date and time specific. In school-holiday months, buy at least two weeks out.

ghibli-museum.note: Tickets go on sale on the 10th of the previous month and there are no walk-up sales.

nozomi.note: Reserved Green Car seats open one month ahead on smartEX. Holiday-period trains sell out.

kyoto-ninja-experience.note: Sessions are small and sell out in school holidays; book at least three days ahead.

kaiseki-gion.note: Private rooms are released a month out and go the same week in high season.

kyoto-sweets-class.note: Book three days ahead; no same-day.
